title: Mexican Fish Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish featuring pan-seared fish, crunchy slaw, and a squeeze of lime juice. Serve with warm tortillas and your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season the fish with fish taco seasoning. Add the fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
In a large bowl, mix together the sour cream, lime juice, and chopped cilantro. Stir in the diced onion and diced tomato.
Assemble the tacos by placing a cooked fish fillet onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the slaw mixture.
Note: For an added crunch, top with diced lettuce or diced radishes.
